The question asks how many hours it would take to clean one-half of the rooms at the KozyInn Motel.

Total rooms: 90
One-half of the rooms: 90 / 2 = 45 rooms
Time to clean each room: 20 minutes

Total time to clean 45 rooms: 45 × 20 = 900 minutes

Convert to hours: 900 / 60 = 15 hours
